01 / Overview

The Problem
We Solved.

Traditional clinic management systems are fragmented — appointment booking lives in one app, patient records in a filing cabinet, and prescriptions printed on paper. This creates a systemic bottleneck that increases wait times and reduces care quality.

Prescripto was architected from the ground up to replace this fragmentation. A single authenticated session gives doctors full patient history, live availability, digital prescriptions, and an integrated video consultation room — all under one roof.
